dedupe_keys.name: belgrade recycling container map jkp gradska cistoca

description: JKP Gradska čistoća, Belgrade's public cleansing and waste collection company, publishes a map of the city's recycling containers as an embedded Google My Maps layer on its website. The map page and the company homepage were read on 2026-09-29. Around the map the site gives the company's service information: rules for depositing recyclables, packaging waste collection, buy-back of recyclables from individuals, price lists for secondary raw materials bought and sold (dated 2 July 2026), prices for collection and transport of municipal waste and for bulky waste, and pages on mosquito, rodent and tick monitoring and control. Coverage: city of Belgrade, Serbia. Format and access: free interactive map; Google My Maps layers can normally be exported as KML. Licence: not stated. Caveats: the map is dated July 2021 on the page and may not reflect current container positions; no attribute list or count was read; the old address beogradskacistoca.rs no longer answers. Simulation uses: service location inputs for waste collection routing and for exposure of collection points to flooding. Related records: compare with Montevideo's waste container lifts (data-montevideo-waste-container-lifts) and Japan's container and packaging recycling data (data-jcpra-japan-container-packaging-recycling-data).
